upstream_interface.description: Network interface connected to the upstream (source) network — e.g., the interface facing the internet or multicast source.

downstream_networks.description: List of downstream (local) networks that will receive multicast traffic. Each entry defines an interface and allowed subnet.

interface.description: Local network interface (e.g., eth1, br0) connected to the downstream subnet.

subnet.description: IPv4 subnet in CIDR notation (e.g., 192.168.1.0/24) allowed to receive multicast traffic on this interface.

name.description: Optional human-readable identifier for this downstream network (used only in comments).
